svg.aria-label: Comic cover of the Cerebro fleet: the navigator at the centre with a beam to every agent, six agent roles and twelve implementers standing on the bead board, and every handover between agents a label on a bead rather than a conversation
svg.text: YOU — AND THERE IS ONLY ONE OF YOU
M-x cerebro · the fleet view is his console
“bead it, ask them, or close it?”
PLANNERS · THEY TURN WANTS INTO PLANS
IMPLEMENTERS · ONE BEAD EACH, THEN A FRESH SESSION
VERIFIER · SHE PUTS IT IN FRONT OF YOU
ARCHITECT · HE READS THE SHAPE OF THE CODE
“this is what it is costing you”
Every handover is a label on a bead.
The board is the only channel they share.
Only he starts or stops a session —
and anything a player sees is his call.
CLOSED IS NOT TERMINAL — A FAILED VERDICT REOPENS THE BEAD AT P0 AND SENDS IT ROUND AGAIN
